title: Ferrari 296 GTB in the Night Studio on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Goals are wishes. Routines are results.
description:
A 3-hour deep focus ambient mix specifically curated for day traders, software developers, and late-night grinders who need to lock in maximum concentration. Perfect background audio loop for chart analysis, coding, and deep workspace productivity.

On screen: a metallic red Ferrari 296 GTB in the Night Studio beside a dual-monitor trading setup. Sound: dark minimal lo-fi: late-night jazz chords and a mellow beat, with soft rain on the glass. No talking, no lyrics.

Every track is original, made for PARKED FM.
